synopsis: Blekinge Institute of Technology participated in the Swedish VaViM program alongside Volvo Autonomous Solutions, from February to August 2022; Chapter 2 describes this as a six-month project [f1550, f15705, f1721]. Both Chapter 2 and the glossary identify Vinnova and Drive Sweden as funding channels [f15705, f1721]. Chapter 2 specifies that VaViM studied validation of virtual models for autonomous vehicle systems operating in a fenced area, but the supplied facts do not describe the institute’s particular responsibilities or project outcomes [f1721].

relations.note: Both identify the same partners and February–August 2022 timeline.
Chapter 2 adds the virtual-model validation focus and fenced-area operating scope.
Adds funding channels and research scope to the same project partners and dates.
